summary: Short turning-head stub, very steep, houses 8-14 m away.

best_section.where: Far end of the stub under trees, past the turning head

drivers.seclusion: Heavy canopy hides it, but houses sit 8 m and 14 m from the early part and about 24 m beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Short sealed dead-end stub with a No Stopping Any Time sign nearby; the usable part is barely a van length.
drivers.traffic: Dead end; almost no through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars were seen parked along the neighbouring lane, but this stub has 2P and No Stopping signs.

flags: Very steep: about 14% over the best section, 16.6% max
No Stopping Any Time sign at the stub
sun_shade: Under dense canopy; shaded most of the day.
